snippet_primary: "Payhip – This was my go-to for years. Even though I'm a professional web developer and build ecommerce websites for clients, I went with the simplest and cheapest option for myself for quite a long time. With Payhip, there's nothing to install on your website and very little barrier to entry. It's definitely my recommendation for beginners. There's no monthly fee, but they charge a 5% transaction fee. Reporting and statistics are not the best in the business, and exporting addresses for shipping was a bit of a headache, but I still recommend them. Perfect is the enemy of done."
